# Benchmarking ClustoCell's marker prioritizations

## Introduction

Script for Benchmarking ClustoCell's marker prioritizations against contemporary methods.

## Function Defintion

We first define some helper functions.

```{r}

# Personalized Theme function

styled_theme <- function(
  style = c("academic", "minimal", "modern", "dark", "classic", "void"),
  border_mode = c("default", "all", "none"),
  title_align = c("center", "left", "right"),
  legends_to_drop = NULL,
  axes_title_drop = FALSE,
  legend_position = c("default", "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "inside"),
  axis_title_face = c("regular", "bold"),
  x_axis_text_angle = 45,
  x_axis_text_y = -0.3,
  remove_margin = c("none", "bottom", "all", "top", "left", "right")
) {
  style <- match.arg(style)
  border_mode <- match.arg(border_mode)
  title_align <- match.arg(title_align)
  legend_position <- match.arg(legend_position)
  axis_title_face <- match.arg(axis_title_face)
  remove_margin <- match.arg(remove_margin)

  base_font <- "Helvetica"
  align_map <- c(left = 0, center = 0.5, right = 1)
  hjust_val <- align_map[title_align]
  thin_size <- 0.3  

  # Decide axis title face
  axis_face_val <- ifelse(axis_title_face == "bold", "bold", "plain")

  # Base theme selection
  if (style == "void") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),  
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "academic") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = hjust_val, color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, color = "grey40"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val, size = 13),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "minimal") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic")
      )
  } else if (style == "modern") {
    theme_out <- theme_light(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "dark") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey30", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "white", hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey80", hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "white", face = axis_face_val),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "white", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "classic") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  }

  # Apply border mode
  if (border_mode == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = thin_size))
  } else if (border_mode == "none") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
  }

  # Drop axes titles if requested
  if (axes_title_drop) {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }

  # Override x-axis text angle and vertical position
  theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = x_axis_text_angle,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = x_axis_text_y)
    )
  )

  # Handle margin removal
  if (remove_margin == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "top") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "bottom") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "left") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(l = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "right") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(r = 0))
  }
  # if "none", do nothing

  # Legend positioning override
  if (legend_position != "default") {
    if (legend_position == "inside") {
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
        legend.direction = "vertical"
      )
    } else {
      horiz <- legend_position %in% c("top", "bottom")
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = legend_position,
        legend.direction = if (horiz) "horizontal" else "vertical"
      )
    }
  }

  # Return theme + guides if needed
  if (!is.null(legends_to_drop)) {
    drop_list <- lapply(legends_to_drop, function(x) "none")
    names(drop_list) <- legends_to_drop
    return(list(theme_out, guides(.list = drop_list)))
  } else {
    return(theme_out)
  }
}

# Label plot
label_plt <- function(label = "Label", size = 1) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    # Draw a single vertical bar
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "lightgrey", color = "black") +
    # Add vertical text (angle=90)
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.5, label = label, size = size,
             angle = 90, size = 6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5) +
    # Remove all extra space
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +             # no axes, ticks, labels
    theme(
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),      # remove outside margins
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),         # remove panel padding
        plot.background = element_blank(),     # no background
        panel.background = element_blank()
    )
}

# Min-Max Normalize function
min_max_norm <- function(x) {
  min_val <- min(x)
  max_val <- max(x)
  if (max_val > min_val) {
    return((x - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
  } else {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }
}

# Create a custom formatter for bolding only Avg.[Score] in the heatmap plots
bold_labeller <- function(x) {
  lapply(x, function(val) {
    if (val == "Median Score") {
      expression(bold("Median Score"))[[1]]
    } else {
      parse(text = val)[[1]]
    }
  }) |> as.expression()
}
```

## Data preparation

## PBMC3K

```{r}

library(patchwork)
library(scplotter)

# SeuratData::InstallData("pbmc3k")
pbmc <- SeuratData::LoadData("pbmc3k")
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

#____________________________________

pbmc$manual_annot <- pbmc$seurat_annotations

pbmc@meta.data <- pbmc@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(major_manual_cellTypes = case_when(
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Naive CD4 T", "Memory CD4 T") ~ "CD4 T",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("B") ~ "B",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("CD8 T", "NK") ~ "CL",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("CD14+ Mono", "FCGR3A+ Mono", "DC") ~ "MNP",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Platelet") ~ "PLT",
    .default = NA
  ))

pbmc$major_manual_cellTypes <- factor(pbmc$major_manual_cellTypes, levels = c("CD4 T", "B", "CL", "MNP", "PLT"))

### Manual annotations

pbmc$manual_annot <- as.character(pbmc$manual_annot)
pbmc$manual_annot <- factor(pbmc$manual_annot, levels = rev(c("Naive CD4 T", "Memory CD4 T", "B", "CD8 T", "NK", "CD14+ Mono", "FCGR3A+ Mono", "DC", "Platelet")))

qs2::qs_save(object = pbmc, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/PBMC3K/pbmc.qs2")
```

## PBMC3K

### R Methods

```{r}

# Importing the markers database
human_pos_marker_db <- read_rds("../../../CelliVerse-Project/Marker Database/human_pos_marker_db.rds")

# PBMC3K manual_annot cell types and their counterparts in the human_pos_marker_db
pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes <- pbmc$manual_annot %>% na.omit() %>% as.character() %>% unique()
pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes <- setNames(pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes, 
                                        nm = c("Memory CD4\\+ T Cell|CD4\\+ Memory T Cell",
                                               "B Cell",
                                               "CD14\\+ Monocyte",
                                               "NK Cell",
                                               "CD8\\+ T",
                                               "Naive CD4\\+ T|CD4\\+ Naive T",
                                               "Non-classical Monocyte",
                                               "Dendritic Cell",
                                               "Platelet"))

any(is.na(pbmc$manual_annot)) # TRUE
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = !is.na(manual_annot))

#______________________________________

# Identifying the markers of each of the manually annotated cell types

# Based on markoClust
pbmc_manual_annot_markoClust <- markoClust(data = pbmc, cluster_labels = "manual_annot", identify_subclusters = F, log1p = T,
                                           high_quantile = 0.25, low_quantile = 0.25, subset_to_HVG = F, seed = 121, verbose = F)

qs2::qs_save(object = pbmc_manual_annot_markoClust, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Deconvolution/pbmc_manual_annot_markoClust.qs2")

pbmc_manual_annot_markoClust <- qs2::qs_read("../../../Benchmarking/Deconvolution/pbmc_manual_annot_markoClust.qs2")

## Checking the top 10 ranked markers of specific clusters
pbmc_manual_annot_markoClust_overlap <- sapply(names(pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes), function(i) {
  grep(
    paste0(paste("^", pbmc_manual_annot_markoClust$markers$major_clusters$cluster_specific$positive_markers[[pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes[[i]]]] %>% 
             dplyr::filter(Rank <= 10) %>% 
             dplyr::pull(Feature), "$", sep = ""), collapse = "|"),
    (human_pos_marker_db %>% dplyr::filter(Tissue == "Blood" & grepl(i, CellType)) %>% dplyr::pull(Marker) %>% unique())
) %>% length()
})

#______________________________________

# Based on FindAllMarkers wilcox method

## find markers for every cluster compared to all remaining cells, report only the positive ones
pbmc.seurat_wilcox_markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, group.by = "manual_annot", test.use = "wilcox", verbose = F)
write_csv(pbmc.seurat_wilcox_markers, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Cluster Marker Identification/pbmc.seurat_wilcox_markers.csv")

## Checking the top 10 ranked markers of specific clusters
pbmc.seurat_wilcox_markers_overlap <- sapply(names(pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes), function(i) {
  grep(
    paste0(paste("^", pbmc.seurat_wilcox_markers %>%
    filter(cluster == pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes[[i]]) %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(Rank = data.table::frank(-avg_log2FC, ties.method = "dense")) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Rank <= 10) %>% 
    dplyr::pull(gene), "$", sep = ""), collapse = "|"),
    (human_pos_marker_db %>% dplyr::filter(Tissue == "Blood" & grepl(i, CellType)) %>% dplyr::pull(Marker) %>% unique())
) %>% length()
})

# Based on Scran (t-test)
# Convert to SingleCellExperiment
pbmc@images <- list()
pbmc_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(pbmc)

# Use the seurat_annotations column as the group/cluster variable
pbmc_sce_clusters <- colData(pbmc_sce)$seurat_annotations

# Optionally compute normalization (Scran style)
pbmc_sce <- computeSumFactors(pbmc_sce)
pbmc_sce <- logNormCounts(pbmc_sce)

# Find markers between all groups using Scran’s "findMarkers"
pbmc_scran_ttest_markers <- findMarkers(pbmc_sce, 
                                        test.type = "t",
                                        groups = pbmc_sce_clusters, 
                                        pval.type = "any")

## Checking the top 10 ranked markers of specific clusters
pbmc_scran_ttest_markers_overlap <- sapply(names(pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes), function(i) {
  grep(
    paste0(paste("^", pbmc_scran_ttest_markers[[pbmc_manual_annot_celltypes[[i]]]] %>%
             as.data.frame() %>% 
               dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>% 
             dplyr::mutate(Rank = data.table::frank(-summary.logFC, ties.method = "dense")) %>% 
             dplyr::filter(Rank <= 10) %>% 
             rownames_to_column("gene") %>% 
               dplyr::pull(gene), "$", sep = ""), collapse = "|"),
    (human_pos_marker_db %>% dplyr::filter(Tissue == "Blood" & grepl(i, CellType)) %>% dplyr::pull(Marker) %>% unique())
) %>% length()
})
```

```{python}

import sys
print(sys.executable)
import os
print(os.getcwd())

import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load expression matrix (genes × cells)
pbmc_matrix = pd.read_csv(
    "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/PBMC3K/pbmc_counts.csv",
    index_col=0               # first column = gene names
)
pbmc_matrix = pbmc_matrix.T   # Scanpy expects cells × genes

# Load metadata
pbmc_metadata = pd.read_csv(
    "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/PBMC3K/pbmc_metadata.csv",
    index_col=0
)

pbmc_metadata.head()
pbmc_matrix.head()

# Align obs to matrix order
pbmc_metadata = pbmc_metadata.loc[pbmc_matrix.index]

# Build AnnData
adata = sc.AnnData(X=pbmc_matrix.values)
adata.var_names = pbmc_matrix.columns
adata.obs_names = pbmc_matrix.index
adata.obs = pbmc_metadata
adata.obs['manual_annot'] = adata.obs['manual_annot'].astype('category')

print(adata)

# Normalize and log-transform the data
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)   # per-cell normalization
sc.pp.log1p(adata)                             # log(1 + x) transform

# Rank marker genes
sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(adata, groupby='manual_annot', method='wilcoxon', n_genes=100)
marker_df = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group=None)
print(marker_df.head())
type(marker_df)
marker_df.shape
```

```{python}

import sys
print(sys.executable)
import os
print(os.getcwd())

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

CODE_PATH = "./"  # adjust path to NS-Forest folder
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(CODE_PATH))

from nsforest import ns, nsforesting, utils, NSFOREST_VERSION

print("NS-Forest version:", NSFOREST_VERSION)

counts_path = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/PBMC3K/pbmc_counts.csv"
meta_path   = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/PBMC3K/pbmc_metadata.csv"

# Read counts and metadata
counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
meta   = pd.read_csv(meta_path, index_col=0)

print(counts.shape, meta.shape)

adata = sc.AnnData(X=counts.transpose())
adata.obs = meta
adata.var_names_make_unique()

cluster_header = "manual_annot"
adata.obs[cluster_header].value_counts()

output_folder = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/PBMC3K/nsforest_output/"
os.makedirs(output_folder, exist_ok=True)

# Dendrogram
ns.pp.dendrogram(adata, cluster_header, save=True,
                 output_folder=output_folder,
                 outputfilename_suffix=cluster_header)

# Prep medians and binary scores
adata_subset = adata.copy()
adata_subset = adata_subset[~adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].isna()].copy()
adata_subset.obs[cluster_header] = adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].astype("category")
print(adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].cat.categories)

adata_subset = ns.pp.prep_medians(adata_subset, cluster_header)
adata_subset = ns.pp.prep_binary_scores(adata_subset, cluster_header)

adata_subset.varm.keys()

adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].value_counts()

# Save preprocessed object
adata_subset.write_h5ad(f"{output_folder}/pbmc3k_preprocessed.h5ad")

results = nsforesting.NSForest(
    adata_subset,
    cluster_header,
    gene_selection=None,
    n_top_genes=50,
    n_binary_genes=50,
    save=True,
    save_supplementary=True,
    output_folder=output_folder,
    outputfilename_prefix="pbmc3k"
)

```

### Combining Methods and Plotting

```{r}

pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df <- cbind(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df,
                                              "Scanpy" = pbmc.scanpy_wilcox_markers_overlap,
                                              "NSForest" = pbmc.nsforest_markers_overlap)

write_csv(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Cluster Marker Identification/pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df.csv")
# pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df <- read_csv("../../../Benchmarking/Cluster Marker Identification/pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df.csv")

#____________

# Preparing the data for plotting

pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df <- pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -Celltype, names_to = "Method", values_to = "Overlap Count")

# Compute cumulative counts for each method
pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals <- pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(`Overlap Count`)) %>%
  mutate(MethodLabel = paste0(Method, "\nTotal = ", Total))

# Merge back to add cumulative labels to legend
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df <- pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df %>%
  left_join(pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals, by = "Method")

# Order cell types and methods by total for aesthetics
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype <- factor(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype, levels = unique(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype))
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method <- factor(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method, levels = pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals$Method[order(-pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals$Total)])

pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals$MethodLabel <- factor(pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals$MethodLabel, 
                                                         levels = pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals$MethodLabel[match(levels(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method),
                                                                                                                      pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals$Method)])

pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals <- pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals[match(levels(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method),
                                                                               pbmc_markers_overlap_method_totals$Method),]

pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method[pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method == "Wilcox-Limma"] <- "Wilcox\nLimma"

## Save the data
write_csv(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Cluster Marker Identification/pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df.csv")

pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df <- read_csv("../../../Benchmarking/Cluster Marker Identification/pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df.csv")

## Shortenning the celltype names
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df <- pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Celltype = case_when(Celltype == "Memory CD4 T" ~ "CD4~T[Mem]", 
                                      Celltype == "CD14+ Mono" ~ "CD14^+~Mono",
                                      Celltype == "FCGR3A+ Mono" ~ "CD16^+~Mono",
                                      Celltype == "Naive CD4 T" ~ "CD4~T[Naive]",
                                     Celltype == "CD8 T" ~ "CD8~T",
                                      .default = Celltype))

pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype <- factor(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype, levels = unique(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype))

#______________________

# Normalizing the results

# Pivot to wide format for scores
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df_wide <- pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Celltype, Method, `Overlap Count`) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = `Overlap Count`) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Celltype")

# Convert to matrix
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix <- as.matrix(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_df_wide)

print(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix)

# Friedman Test
# Run Friedman test on the ranks
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_friedman_result <- friedman.test(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix)  # Or use pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_ranks_matrix if preferring ranks
print(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_friedman_result)

pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix <- t(apply(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix, 1, min_max_norm))

# Median per method (higher = better)
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized <- colMedians(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix)
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized <- round(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized, 2)
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix <- rbind(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix, "Median Score" = pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized)

print(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix)
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized <- sort(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized, decreasing = T)

pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix <- pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix[,names(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized)]
print(sort(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized, decreasing = TRUE))

# Convert matrix to long data frame
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat <- reshape2::melt(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix)
colnames(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat) <- c("Row", "Column", "value")

# Create a column that contains value only for Median Score rows
pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat <- pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat %>%
  mutate(label_val = ifelse(Row == "Median Score", sprintf("%.2f", value), NA))

levels(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat$Column) <- names(pbmc_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized)
```

```{r}

# Importing the markers database
human_pos_marker_db <- read_rds("../../../CelliVerse-Project/Marker Database/human_pos_marker_db.rds")

# liver_tumor_adj manual_annot cell types and their counterparts in the human_pos_marker_db

liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_celltypes <- liver_tumor_adj$minor_manual_annot1 %>% na.omit() %>% as.character() %>% unique()
liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_celltypes <- setNames(liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_celltypes, 
                                                   nm = c("Lymphocyte", 
                                                          "Myeloid Cell", 
                                                          "Endothelial Cell", 
                                                          "Smooth Muscle Cell", 
                                                          "Cholangiocyte", 
                                                          "Hepatocyte"
                                                   ))


#______________________________________

# Identifying the markers of each of the manually annotated cell types

# Based on markoClust
liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_markoClust <- markoClust(data = liver_tumor_adj, cluster_labels = "minor_manual_annot1", identify_subclusters = F,
                                                      high_quantile = 0.25, low_quantile = 0.25, subset_to_HVG = F, seed = 121, verbose = F)

qs2::qs_save(object = liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_markoClust, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Deconvolution/liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_markoClust.qs2")

liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_markoClust <- qs2::qs_read("../../../Benchmarking/Deconvolution/liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_markoClust.qs2")

## Checking the top 10 ranked markers of specific clusters
liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_markoClust_overlap <- sapply(names(liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_celltypes), function(i) {
  grep(
    paste0(paste("^", liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_markoClust$markers$major_clusters$cluster_specific$positive_markers[[liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_celltypes[[i]]]] %>% 
             dplyr::filter(Rank <= 10) %>% 
             dplyr::pull(Feature), "$", sep = ""), collapse = "|"),
    (human_pos_marker_db %>% dplyr::filter(Tissue == "Liver" & grepl(i, CellType)) %>% dplyr::pull(Marker) %>% unique())
  ) %>% length()
})

# Based on Scran (t-test)
# Convert to SingleCellExperiment
liver_tumor_adj@images <- list()
liver_tumor_adj_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(liver_tumor_adj)

# Use the major_manual_annot column as the group/cluster variable
liver_tumor_adj_sce_clusters <- colData(liver_tumor_adj_sce)$minor_manual_annot1

# Optionally compute normalization (Scran style)
liver_tumor_adj_sce <- computeSumFactors(liver_tumor_adj_sce)
liver_tumor_adj_sce <- logNormCounts(liver_tumor_adj_sce)

# Find markers between all groups using Scran’s "findMarkers"
liver_tumor_adj_scran_ttest_markers <- findMarkers(liver_tumor_adj_sce, 
                                                   test.type = "t",
                                                   groups = liver_tumor_adj_sce_clusters, 
                                                   pval.type = "any")

## Checking the top 10 ranked markers of specific clusters
liver_tumor_adj_scran_ttest_markers_overlap <- sapply(names(liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_celltypes), function(i) {
  grep(
    paste0(paste("^", liver_tumor_adj_scran_ttest_markers[[liver_tumor_adj_manual_annot_celltypes[[i]]]] %>%
             as.data.frame() %>% 
             dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>% 
             dplyr::mutate(Rank = data.table::frank(-summary.logFC, ties.method = "dense")) %>% 
             dplyr::filter(Rank <= 10) %>% 
             rownames_to_column("gene") %>% 
             dplyr::pull(gene), "$", sep = ""), collapse = "|"),
    (human_pos_marker_db %>% dplyr::filter(Tissue == "Liver" & grepl(i, CellType)) %>% dplyr::pull(Marker) %>% unique())
  ) %>% length()
})
```

```{python}

import sys
print(sys.executable)
import os
print(os.getcwd())

import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load expression matrix (genes × cells)
liver_tumor_adj_matrix = pd.read_csv(
  "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_counts.csv",
  index_col=0               # first column = gene names
)

liver_tumor_adj_matrix = liver_tumor_adj_matrix.T   # Scanpy expects cells × genes

# Load metadata
liver_tumor_adj_metadata = pd.read_csv(
  "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_metadata.csv",
  index_col=0
)

liver_tumor_adj_metadata.head()
liver_tumor_adj_matrix.head()

# Align obs to matrix order
liver_tumor_adj_metadata = liver_tumor_adj_metadata.loc[liver_tumor_adj_matrix.index]

# Build AnnData
adata = sc.AnnData(X=liver_tumor_adj_matrix.values)
adata.var_names = liver_tumor_adj_matrix.columns
adata.obs_names = liver_tumor_adj_matrix.index
adata.obs = liver_tumor_adj_metadata
adata.obs['minor_manual_annot1'] = adata.obs['minor_manual_annot1'].astype('category')

print(adata)

# Normalize and log-transform the data
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)   # per-cell normalization
sc.pp.log1p(adata)                             # log(1 + x) transform

# Rank marker genes
sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(adata, groupby='minor_manual_annot1', method='wilcoxon', n_genes=100)
marker_df = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group=None)
print(marker_df.head())
type(marker_df)
marker_df.shape
```

```{python}

import sys
print(sys.executable)
import os
print(os.getcwd())

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

CODE_PATH = "./"  # adjust path to NS-Forest folder
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(CODE_PATH))

from nsforest import ns, nsforesting, utils, NSFOREST_VERSION

print("NS-Forest version:", NSFOREST_VERSION)

counts_path = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_counts.csv"
meta_path   = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_metadata.csv"

# Read counts and metadata
counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
meta   = pd.read_csv(meta_path, index_col=0)

print(counts.shape, meta.shape)

adata = sc.AnnData(X=counts.transpose())
adata.obs = meta
adata.var_names_make_unique()

cluster_header = "minor_manual_annot1"
adata.obs[cluster_header].value_counts()

output_folder = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/nsforest_output/"
os.makedirs(output_folder, exist_ok=True)

# Dendrogram
ns.pp.dendrogram(adata, cluster_header, save=True,
                 output_folder=output_folder,
                 outputfilename_suffix=cluster_header)

# Prep medians and binary scores
adata_subset = adata.copy()
adata_subset = adata_subset[~adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].isna()].copy()
adata_subset.obs[cluster_header] = adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].astype("category")
print(adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].cat.categories)

adata_subset = ns.pp.prep_medians(adata_subset, cluster_header)
adata_subset = ns.pp.prep_binary_scores(adata_subset, cluster_header)

adata_subset.varm.keys()

adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].value_counts()

# Save preprocessed object
adata_subset.write_h5ad(f"{output_folder}/liver_tumor_adj_preprocessed.h5ad")

results = nsforesting.NSForest(
  adata_subset,
  cluster_header,
  gene_selection=None,
  n_top_genes=50,
  n_binary_genes=50,
  save=True,
  save_supplementary=True,
  output_folder=output_folder,
  outputfilename_prefix="liver_tumor_adj"
)

```

```{r}
#____________

# Preparing the data for plotting

liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df <- liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_raw_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -Celltype, names_to = "Method", values_to = "Overlap Count")

# Compute cumulative counts for each method
liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals <- liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(`Overlap Count`)) %>%
  mutate(MethodLabel = paste0(Method, "\nTotal = ", Total))

# Merge back to add cumulative labels to legend
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df <- liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df %>%
  left_join(liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals, by = "Method")

# Order cell types and methods by total for aesthetics
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype <- factor(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype, levels = unique(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype))
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method <- factor(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method, levels = liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals$Method[order(-liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals$Total)])

liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals$MethodLabel <- factor(liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals$MethodLabel, 
                                                                    levels = liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals$MethodLabel[match(levels(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method),
                                                                                                                                             liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals$Method)])

liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals <- liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals[match(levels(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method),
                                                                                                     liver_tumor_adj_markers_overlap_method_totals$Method),]

liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method[liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Method == "Limma"] <- "Wilcox\nLimma"

## Save the data
write_csv(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Cluster Marker Identification/liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df.csv")

liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df <- read_csv("../../../Benchmarking/Cluster Marker Identification/liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df.csv")

liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype <- factor(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype, levels = unique(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df$Celltype))

#______________________

# Normalizing the results


# Pivot to wide format for scores
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df_wide <- liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Celltype, Method, `Overlap Count`) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = `Overlap Count`) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Celltype")

# Convert to matrix
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix <- as.matrix(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_df_wide)

print(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix)

# Friedman Test
# Run Friedman test on the ranks
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_friedman_result <- friedman.test(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix)  # Or use liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_ranks_matrix if preferring ranks
print(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_friedman_result)

liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix <- t(apply(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_scores_matrix, 1, min_max_norm))

# Median per method (higher = better)
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized <- colMedians(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix)
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized <- round(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized, 2)
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix <- rbind(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix, 
                                                                    "Median Score" = liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized)


print(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix)
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized <- sort(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized, decreasing = T)

liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix <- liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix[,names(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized)]
print(sort(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized, decreasing = TRUE))

# Convert matrix to long data frame
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat <- reshape2::melt(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_matrix)
colnames(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat) <- c("Row", "Column", "value")

# Create a column that contains value only for Median Score rows
liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat <- liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat %>%
  mutate(label_val = ifelse(Row == "Median Score", sprintf("%.2f", value), NA))

levels(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_normalized_df_heat$Column) <- names(liver_tumor_adj_combined_markers_overlap_med_normalized)
```

```{r}
prostateimmuneatlas_manual_annot_markoClust_overlap <- sapply(names(prostateimmuneatlas_manual_annot_celltypes), function(i) {

    paste0(paste("^", prostateimmuneatlas_manual_annot_markoClust$markers$major_clusters$cluster_specific$positive_markers[[prostateimmuneatlas_manual_annot_celltypes[[i]]]] %>% 
             dplyr::filter(Rank <= 10) %>% 
             dplyr::pull(Feature), "$", sep = ""), collapse = "|"),
    (human_pos_marker_db %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(i, CellType)) %>% dplyr::pull(Marker) %>% unique())
  ) %>% length()
})

# Convert to SingleCellExperiment
prostateimmuneatlas@images <- list()
prostateimmuneatlas_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(prostateimmuneatlas)

# Use the manual_annot column as the group/cluster variable
prostateimmuneatlas_sce_clusters <- colData(prostateimmuneatlas_sce)$manual_annot

# Optionally compute normalization (Scran style)
prostateimmuneatlas_sce <- computeSumFactors(prostateimmuneatlas_sce)
prostateimmuneatlas_sce <- logNormCounts(prostateimmuneatlas_sce)

# Find markers between all groups using Scran’s "findMarkers"
prostateimmuneatlas_scran_ttest_markers <- findMarkers(prostateimmuneatlas_sce, 
                                                       test.type = "t",
                                                       groups = prostateimmuneatlas_sce_clusters, 
                                                       pval.type = "any")

## Checking the top 10 ranked markers of specific clusters
prostateimmuneatlas_scran_ttest_markers_overlap <- sapply(names(prostateimmuneatlas_manual_annot_celltypes), function(i) {
  grep(
    paste0(paste("^", prostateimmuneatlas_scran_ttest_markers[[prostateimmuneatlas_manual_annot_celltypes[[i]]]] %>%
                   as.data.frame() %>% 
                   dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>% 
                   dplyr::mutate(Rank = data.table::frank(-summary.logFC, ties.method = "dense")) %>% 
                   dplyr::filter(Rank <= 10) %>% 
                   rownames_to_column("gene") %>% 
                   dplyr::pull(gene), "$", sep = ""), collapse = "|"),
    (human_pos_marker_db %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(i, CellType)) %>% dplyr::pull(Marker) %>% unique())
  ) %>% length()
})
```

```{python}

import sys
print(sys.executable)
import os
print(os.getcwd())

import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load expression matrix (genes × cells)
prostateimmuneatlas_matrix = pd.read_csv(
  "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Prostate Cancer Cell Atlas/prostateimmuneatlas_counts.csv",
  index_col=0               # first column = gene names
)
prostateimmuneatlas_matrix = prostateimmuneatlas_matrix.T   # Scanpy expects cells × genes

# Load metadata
prostateimmuneatlas_metadata = pd.read_csv(
  "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Prostate Cancer Cell Atlas/prostateimmuneatlas_metadata.csv",
  index_col=0
)

prostateimmuneatlas_metadata.head()
prostateimmuneatlas_matrix.head()

# Align obs to matrix order
prostateimmuneatlas_metadata = prostateimmuneatlas_metadata.loc[prostateimmuneatlas_matrix.index]

# Build AnnData
adata = sc.AnnData(X=prostateimmuneatlas_matrix.values)
adata.var_names = prostateimmuneatlas_matrix.columns
adata.obs_names = prostateimmuneatlas_matrix.index
adata.obs = prostateimmuneatlas_metadata
adata.obs['manual_annot'] = adata.obs['manual_annot'].astype('category')

print(adata)

# Normalize and log-transform the data
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)   # per-cell normalization
sc.pp.log1p(adata)                             # log(1 + x) transform

# Rank marker genes
sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(adata, groupby='manual_annot', method='wilcoxon', n_genes=100)
marker_df = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group=None)
print(marker_df.head())
type(marker_df)
marker_df.shape
```

```{python}
import sys

from nsforest import ns, nsforesting, utils, NSFOREST_VERSION

meta_path   = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Prostate Cancer Cell Atlas/prostateimmuneatlas_metadata.csv"

# Read counts and metadata
counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
meta   = pd.read_csv(meta_path, index_col=0)

print(counts.shape, meta.shape)

adata = sc.AnnData(X=counts.transpose())
adata.obs = meta
adata.var_names_make_unique()

cluster_header = "manual_annot"
adata.obs[cluster_header].value_counts()

output_folder = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Prostate Cancer Cell Atlas/nsforest_output/"
os.makedirs(output_folder, exist_ok=True)

# Dendrogram
ns.pp.dendrogram(adata, cluster_header, save=True,
                 output_folder=output_folder,
                 outputfilename_suffix=cluster_header)

# Prep medians and binary scores
adata_subset = adata.copy()
adata_subset = adata_subset[~adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].isna()].copy()
adata_subset.obs[cluster_header] = adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].astype("category")
print(adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].cat.categories)

adata_subset = ns.pp.prep_medians(adata_subset, cluster_header)
adata_subset = ns.pp.prep_binary_scores(adata_subset, cluster_header)

adata_subset.varm.keys()

adata_subset.obs[cluster_header].value_counts()

# Save preprocessed object
adata_subset.write_h5ad(f"{output_folder}/prostateimmuneatlas_preprocessed.h5ad")

results = nsforesting.NSForest(
  adata_subset,
  cluster_header,
  gene_selection=None,
  n_top_genes=50,
  n_binary_genes=50,
  save=True,
  save_supplementary=True,
  output_folder=output_folder,
  outputfilename_prefix="prostateimmuneatlas"
)
```

## Compare with Default DWLS

```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# DWLS Benchmark: Published Default vs. MarkoClust Markers
# ==============================================================================
# This script performs a paired benchmarking of DWLS deconvolution using:
#   1. The published default signature matrix (MAST/Seurat DE pipeline)
#   2. A custom signature matrix built from pbmc_markoClust_markers
#
# Pseudobulk generation: 100 samples of 1000 random cells each from pbmc10k.
# Reference: pbmc single-cell data.
# Evaluation: Pearson, Spearman, CCC, RMSE, MAE (per bulk & per cell type).
# ==============================================================================

# --- 0. CONFIGURATION ---------------------------------------------------------
# Set to "MAST" for the published default (as shown in the DWLS manual/paper)
# or "Seurat" to use buildSignatureMatrixUsingSeurat() instead.
DEFAULT_METHOD <- "Seurat"  

# Number of pseudobulk samples and cells per sample
N_BULK       <- 100
CELLS_BULK   <- 1000

# Bootstrap replicates for confidence intervals
BOOT_R       <- 5000

# Output directory
OUT_DIR      <- "../../../Benchmarking/Deconvolution/DWLS/DWLS_benchmark_results"

# --- 1. PACKAGES & DWLS FUNCTIONS ---------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
  library(DescTools)
  library(boot)
  library(purrr)
})

# Source the DWLS functions (edit path if necessary)
DWLS_SOURCE <- "../../../Benchmarking/Deconvolution/DWLS/Deconvolution_functions.R"
if (!file.exists(DWLS_SOURCE)) {
  stop("DWLS functions file not found: ", DWLS_SOURCE)
}
source(DWLS_SOURCE)

# Create output directory
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# --- 2. VERIFY INPUT OBJECTS --------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("pbmc")) stop("Seurat object 'pbmc' not found in environment.")
if (!exists("pbmc10k")) stop("Seurat object 'pbmc10k' not found in environment.")
if (!exists("pbmc_markoClust_markers")) {
  stop("Marker list 'pbmc_markoClust_markers' not found in environment.")
}

# --- 3. EXTRACT DATA ----------------------------------------------------------
# Reference (pbmc) — convert to dense matrix for DWLS signature building
pbmc_counts <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(pbmc, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"))
pbmc_labels <- pbmc$manual_annot

# Target (pbmc10k) — keep sparse for efficient rowSums
counts_10k  <- GetAssayData(pbmc10k, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
labels_10k  <- pbmc10k$manual_annot_summary

# Unified cell-type universe (union of both datasets)
all_celltypes <- sort(union(unique(as.character(pbmc_labels)), 
                            unique(as.character(labels_10k))))
cat("Cell-type universe (", length(all_celltypes), "):\n", 
    paste(all_celltypes, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# --- 4. PSEUDOBULK GENERATION -------------------------------------------------
set.seed(121)
pseudobulk_list <- vector("list", N_BULK)
truth_list      <- vector("list", N_BULK)

for (i in seq_len(N_BULK)) {
  set.seed(100 + i)
  sampled_cells <- sample(colnames(counts_10k), CELLS_BULK)
  
  # Sum raw counts
  bulk_counts   <- Matrix::rowSums(counts_10k[, sampled_cells, drop = FALSE])
  
  # True proportions (cell types absent in sample get 0)
  tab <- table(factor(labels_10k[sampled_cells], levels = all_celltypes))
  prop <- as.numeric(tab) / sum(tab)
  names(prop) <- all_celltypes
  
  pseudobulk_list[[i]] <- bulk_counts
  truth_list[[i]]      <- prop
}

# Convert truth to matrix (rows = bulks, cols = cell types)
truth_mat <- do.call(rbind, truth_list)
cat("Generated", N_BULK, "pseudobulk samples (", CELLS_BULK, "cells each).\n\n")

# --- 5. SIGNATURE MATRIX CONSTRUCTION -----------------------------------------

# 5A. Published default DWLS signature -----------------------------------------
cat("Building DEFAULT DWLS signature matrix (method =", DEFAULT_METHOD, ") ...\n")
de_dir_default <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "DE_default")
dir.create(de_dir_default, showWarnings = FALSE)

# if (DEFAULT_METHOD == "MAST") {
#   Sig_default <- buildSignatureMatrixMAST(
#     scdata      = pbmc_counts,
#     id          = pbmc_labels,
#     path        = de_dir_default,
#     diff.cutoff = 0.5,
#     pval.cutoff = 0.01
#   )
# } else {
#   Sig_default <- buildSignatureMatrixUsingSeurat(
#     scdata      = pbmc_counts,
#     id          = pbmc_labels,
#     path        = de_dir_default,
#     diff.cutoff = 0.5,
#     pval.cutoff = 0.01
#   )
# }

# Default function returns error as it uses old Seurat, creating an identical function that works with the current version of Seurat:

#__________________________
# Helper:

#' Replicate buildSignatureMatrixUsingSeurat logic with modern Seurat
build_signature_default <- function(obj, label_col, diff.cutoff = 0.5, pval.cutoff = 0.01) {
  obj <- SetIdent(obj, value = label_col)
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  labels <- as.character(obj[[label_col, drop = TRUE]])
  
  # Run DE using modern Seurat (wilcox is the current default; original used bimod)
  de_all <- FindAllMarkers(
    obj,
    only.pos      = TRUE,
    test.use      = "wilcox",
    logfc.threshold = diff.cutoff,
    min.pct       = 0.1
  )
  
  # Filter as in original code
  de_filtered <- de_all[de_all$p_val_adj < pval.cutoff & de_all$avg_log2FC > diff.cutoff, ]
  
  cell_types <- sort(unique(labels))
  numberofGenes <- c()
  cluster_tables <- list()
  
  for (i in cell_types) {
    ct_de <- de_filtered[de_filtered$cluster == i, ]
    if (nrow(ct_de) == 0) {
      numberofGenes <- c(numberofGenes, 0)
      cluster_tables[[i]] <- data.frame()
      next
    }
    nonMir <- grep("MIR|Mir", ct_de$gene, invert = TRUE)
    ct_de <- ct_de[nonMir, , drop = FALSE]
    # Original orders by p_val_adj DECREASING (least significant among significant first)
    ct_de <- ct_de[order(ct_de$p_val_adj, decreasing = TRUE), ]
    cluster_tables[[i]] <- ct_de
    numberofGenes <- c(numberofGenes, nrow(ct_de))
  }
  names(numberofGenes) <- cell_types
  
  # Iterate G = 50:200 (or max available) and choose lowest condition number
  max_g <- min(200, max(numberofGenes[numberofGenes > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
  if (max_g < 50) stop("Too few DE genes to build default signature.")
  G_range <- 50:max_g
  
  conditionNumbers <- c()
  for (G in G_range) {
    Genes <- c()
    for (i in cell_types) {
      if (numberofGenes[i] > 0) {
        temp <- cluster_tables[[i]]
        n_take <- min(G, numberofGenes[i])
        Genes <- c(Genes, temp$gene[1:n_take])
      }
    }
    Genes <- unique(Genes)
    if (length(Genes) < 2) next
    
    ExprSubset <- counts[Genes, , drop = FALSE]
    Sig <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
      Matrix::rowMeans(ExprSubset[, labels == ct, drop = FALSE])
    })
    conditionNumbers <- c(conditionNumbers, kappa(Sig))
  }
  
  if (length(conditionNumbers) == 0) stop("No valid default signature matrix could be constructed.")
  
  optimal_idx <- which.min(conditionNumbers)
  G <- G_range[optimal_idx]
  
  # Build final signature with optimal G
  Genes <- c()
  for (i in cell_types) {
    if (numberofGenes[i] > 0) {
      temp <- cluster_tables[[i]]
      n_take <- min(G, numberofGenes[i])
      Genes <- c(Genes, temp$gene[1:n_take])
    }
  }
  Genes <- unique(Genes)
  ExprSubset <- counts[Genes, , drop = FALSE]
  Sig <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(ExprSubset[, labels == ct, drop = FALSE])
  })
  
  return(Sig)
}

#__________________________

  Sig_default <- build_signature_default(
    obj         = pbmc,
    label_col   = "manual_annot",
    diff.cutoff = 0.5,
    pval.cutoff = 0.01
  )

cat("  Default signature:", nrow(Sig_default), "genes x", ncol(Sig_default), "cell types.\n")

# 5B. MarkoClust custom signature ----------------------------------------------
buildSignatureMatrixFromMarkoClust <- function(scdata, id, markers_list) {
  # markers_list: named list, names = cell types, values = character vectors of genes
  common_ct <- intersect(names(markers_list), unique(as.character(id)))
  if (length(common_ct) == 0) stop("No matching cell types between markers and labels.")
  
  all_markers <- unique(unlist(markers_list[common_ct]))
  genes <- intersect(all_markers, rownames(scdata))
  if (length(genes) == 0) stop("No marker genes found in reference data.")
  
  expr_subset <- scdata[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  
  Sig <- sapply(common_ct, function(ct) {
    cells <- which(id == ct)
    if (length(cells) == 0) return(rep(0, length(genes)))
    rowMeans(expr_subset[, cells, drop = FALSE])
  })
  
  rownames(Sig) <- genes
  colnames(Sig) <- common_ct
  return(Sig)
}

cat("Building MARKOCLUST signature matrix ...\n")
Sig_marko <- buildSignatureMatrixFromMarkoClust(
  scdata       = pbmc_counts,
  id           = pbmc_labels,
  markers_list = pbmc_markoClust_markers
)
cat("  MarkoClust signature:", nrow(Sig_marko), "genes x", ncol(Sig_marko), "cell types.\n\n")

# --- 6. DECONVOLUTION FUNCTION ------------------------------------------------
safe_deconvolve <- function(Sig, bulk_list, method_label) {
  n <- length(bulk_list)
  results <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = length(all_celltypes))
  colnames(results) <- all_celltypes
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    bulk <- bulk_list[[i]]
    tr   <- trimData(Sig, bulk)
    
    # Check we have genes and cell types after trimming
    if (nrow(tr$sig) > 0 && ncol(tr$sig) > 0 && length(tr$bulk) > 0) {
      sol <- tryCatch({
        # Suppress printed iteration output from solveDampenedWLS
        junk <- capture.output(s <- solveDampenedWLS(tr$sig, tr$bulk))
        s
      }, error = function(e) {
        warning(sprintf("[%s] Bulk %d failed: %s", method_label, i, conditionMessage(e)))
        setNames(rep(0, ncol(tr$sig)), colnames(tr$sig))
      })
    } else {
      sol <- setNames(rep(0, ncol(Sig)), colnames(Sig))
    }
    
    results[i, names(sol)] <- sol
  }
  return(results)
}

# --- 7. RUN DECONVOLUTION -----------------------------------------------------
cat("Running deconvolution with DEFAULT signature ...\n")
pred_default <- safe_deconvolve(Sig_default, pseudobulk_list, "DWLS")

cat("Running deconvolution with MARKOCLUST signature ...\n")
pred_marko   <- safe_deconvolve(Sig_marko,   pseudobulk_list, "MarkoClust-DWLS")

# Save raw predictions
saveRDS(list(truth = truth_mat, 
             DWLS = pred_default, 
             MarkoClust = pred_marko),
        file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "deconvolution_predictions.rds"))

# --- 8. METRIC FUNCTIONS ------------------------------------------------------
metric_summary <- function(truth, pred) {
  stopifnot(length(truth) == length(pred))
  
  pearson  <- tryCatch(cor(truth, pred, method = "pearson"),  error = function(e) NA_real_)
  spearman <- tryCatch(cor(truth, pred, method = "spearman"), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  ccc      <- tryCatch(DescTools::CCC(truth, pred)$rho.c,     error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  tibble(
    Pearson  = pearson,
    Spearman = spearman,
    CCC      = ccc,
    RMSE     = sqrt(mean((pred - truth)^2)),
    MAE      = mean(abs(pred - truth)),
  )
}

celltype_metrics <- function(truth_mat, pred_mat, method_name) {
  celltypes <- colnames(truth_mat)
  
  bind_rows(lapply(celltypes, function(ct) {
    t_vec <- truth_mat[, ct]
    p_vec <- pred_mat[, ct]
    
    # Only compute correlations if there is variance in both vectors
    pearson  <- if (sd(t_vec) == 0 || sd(p_vec) == 0) NA_real_ else cor(t_vec, p_vec, method = "pearson")
    spearman <- if (sd(t_vec) == 0 || sd(p_vec) == 0) NA_real_ else cor(t_vec, p_vec, method = "spearman")
    ccc      <- tryCatch(DescTools::CCC(t_vec, p_vec)$rho.c, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
    tibble(
      CellType = ct,
      Method   = method_name,
      Pearson  = pearson,
      Spearman = spearman,
      CCC      = ccc,
      RMSE     = sqrt(mean((p_vec - t_vec)^2)),
      MAE      = mean(abs(p_vec - t_vec))
    )
  }))
}

boot_diff_ci <- function(x, y, R = BOOT_R) {
  d <- x - y
  if (length(d) == 0 || all(is.na(d))) {
    return(list(Mean = NA_real_, Lower = NA_real_, Upper = NA_real_))
  }
  stat <- function(data, idx) mean(data[idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  b <- boot::boot(d, statistic = stat, R = R)
  ci <- boot::boot.ci(b, type = "perc")
  list(
    Mean  = mean(d, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower = ci$percent[4],
    Upper = ci$percent[5]
  )
}

# --- 9. COMPUTE METRICS -------------------------------------------------------
# Per-pseudobulk
bulk_metrics <- map_dfr(seq_len(N_BULK), function(i) {
  bind_rows(
    metric_summary(truth_mat[i, ], pred_default[i, ]) %>% 
      mutate(Method = "DWLS", Bulk = i),
    metric_summary(truth_mat[i, ], pred_marko[i, ]) %>% 
      mutate(Method = "MarkoClust-DWLS", Bulk = i)
  )
})

bulk_metrics$CCC <- bulk_metrics$CCC$est

# Per-cell-type
ct_metrics <- bind_rows(
  celltype_metrics(truth_mat, pred_default, "DWLS"),
  celltype_metrics(truth_mat, pred_marko,   "MarkoClust-DWLS")
)

ct_metrics$CCC <- ct_metrics$CCC$est

# Save tables
write.csv(bulk_metrics, file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "metrics_per_bulk.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ct_metrics,   file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "metrics_per_celltype.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# --- 10. PAIRED STATISTICAL TESTS ---------------------------------------------
metrics_names <- c("Pearson", "Spearman", "CCC", "RMSE", "MAE")

paired_wide <- bulk_metrics %>%
  dplyr::select(Bulk, Method, all_of(metrics_names)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = all_of(metrics_names))

# Run paired tests and bootstrap CIs
stat_results <- map_dfr(metrics_names, function(m) {
  dwls_vals  <- bulk_metrics %>% dplyr::filter(Method == "DWLS") %>% dplyr::pull(!!sym(m))
  mark_vals  <- bulk_metrics %>% dplyr::filter(Method == "MarkoClust-DWLS") %>% dplyr::pull(!!sym(m))
  
  # Paired t-test
  tt <- tryCatch(t.test(mark_vals, dwls_vals, paired = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  # Paired Wilcoxon
  wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(mark_vals, dwls_vals, paired = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  # Bootstrap CI of difference (MarkoClust - DWLS)
  bci <- boot_diff_ci(mark_vals, dwls_vals)
  
  tibble(
    Metric      = m,
    Mean_DWLS   = mean(dwls_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Marko  = mean(mark_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Diff_Mean   = bci$Mean,
    CI_Lower    = bci$Lower,
    CI_Upper    = bci$Upper,
    t_pvalue    = if (!is.null(tt)) tt$p.value else NA_real_,
    wilcox_pvalue = if (!is.null(wt)) wt$p.value else NA_real_
  )
})

write.csv(stat_results, file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "paired_statistics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(stat_results)

# --- 11. PUBLICATION-QUALITY FIGURES ------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)

      wilcox_pvalue < 0.001 ~ "***",

    )
  )
```

## Compare with Default BayesPrism

```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# BayesPrism Benchmark: Published Default Pipeline vs. MarkoClust (ClustoCell) Markers
# ==============================================================================
# Paired benchmarking of BayesPrism cell-type deconvolution using:
#   1. DEFAULT  ("BayesPrism")            - full published tutorial pipeline:
#        cleanup.genes -> select.gene.type(protein_coding)
#        -> get.exp.stat + select.marker  -> new.prism -> run.prism
#   2. CUSTOM   ("ClustoCell-BayesPrism") - same BayesPrism engine, but the
#        reference gene space is restricted to the union of the user-provided
#        pbmc_markoClust_markers (markers used as-is; cleanup.genes skipped)
#        -> new.prism -> run.prism
#
# Pseudobulk generation : 100 samples of 1000 random cells each from pbmc10k.
# Reference             : pbmc single-cell data (labels in pbmc$manual_annot).
# Evaluation            : Pearson, Spearman, CCC, RMSE, MAE (per bulk & per cell type),
#                         paired t-test + Wilcoxon + bootstrap CIs, publication figures.
#
# This script mirrors the structure, pseudobulk design, metrics, statistics and
# figures of the companion DWLS benchmark so the two methods are directly comparable.
# ==============================================================================


# --- 0. CONFIGURATION ---------------------------------------------------------

# Pseudobulk design (must match the DWLS benchmark for comparability)
N_BULK        <- 100        # number of pseudobulk samples
CELLS_BULK    <- 1000       # cells summed per pseudobulk sample

# Bootstrap replicates for confidence intervals on metric differences
BOOT_R        <- 5000

# BayesPrism / marker-selection parameters
SPECIES       <- "hs"       # "hs" (human) or "mm" (mouse). Genes here are human SYMBOLS.
PSEUDO_COUNT  <- 0.1        # get.exp.stat log2 pseudocount: 0.1 for 10x, 10 for smart-seq
CELL_COUNT_CUT<- 50         # get.exp.stat: min cells per state for pairwise t-test
PVAL_MAX      <- 0.01       # select.marker: max p-value for signature genes
LFC_MIN       <- 0.1        # select.marker: min log2 fold-change for signature genes
EXP_CELLS     <- 5          # cleanup.genes: drop genes expressed in < this many cells
OUTLIER_CUT   <- 0.01       # new.prism: outlier expression fraction cutoff
OUTLIER_FRAC  <- 0.1        # new.prism: outlier fraction of bulk samples
MIN_MARKERS_PER_CT <- 50    # warn (per tutorial) if fewer markers/cell type after selection

# Parallelism for run.prism Gibbs sampling (main runtime lever)
N_CORES       <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

# Reproducibility
SEED_GLOBAL   <- 121        # global seed (pseudobulk driver)
SEED_BP       <- 2024       # seed set before each run.prism

# Output directory
OUT_DIR       <- "../../../Benchmarking/Deconvolution/BayesPrism/BayesPrism_benchmark_results"

# --- 1. PACKAGES --------------------------------------------------------------
# BayesPrism install (if needed):
#   install.packages("remotes")
#   remotes::install_github("Danko-Lab/BayesPrism/BayesPrism")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
  library(DescTools)
  library(boot)
  library(purrr)
})

if (!requireNamespace("BayesPrism", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'BayesPrism' not installed. Install with:\n",
       "  remotes::install_github(\"Danko-Lab/BayesPrism/BayesPrism\")")
}
suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(BayesPrism)))

# svglite for editable-text SVG (fallback to grDevices::svg if unavailable)
HAVE_SVGLITE <- requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)


# --- 2. VERIFY INPUT OBJECTS --------------------------------------------------
# Objects are assumed already loaded in the environment (as in the DWLS script).
# Optional: load from disk by uncommenting and editing the paths below.
# pbmc                    <- readRDS("pbmc.rds")
# pbmc10k                 <- readRDS("pbmc10k.rds")
# pbmc_markoClust_markers <- readRDS("pbmc_markoClust_markers.rds")

if (!exists("pbmc"))    stop("Seurat object 'pbmc' not found in environment.")
if (!exists("pbmc10k")) stop("Seurat object 'pbmc10k' not found in environment.")
if (!exists("pbmc_markoClust_markers"))
  stop("Marker list 'pbmc_markoClust_markers' not found in environment.")


# --- 3. EXTRACT DATA ----------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT ORIENTATION NOTE:
#   Seurat stores counts as genes x cells.
#   BayesPrism expects matrices as (cells/samples) x genes  -- i.e. the TRANSPOSE.
#   We transpose explicitly wherever a matrix is handed to BayesPrism.

# Reference (pbmc): genes x cells -> transpose to cells x genes (dense, required by BayesPrism)
ref_gc      <- GetAssayData(pbmc, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")   # genes x cells (sparse)
sc.dat      <- as.matrix(Matrix::t(ref_gc))                           # cells x genes (dense)
pbmc_labels <- as.character(pbmc$manual_annot)                        # length = nrow(sc.dat)
stopifnot(nrow(sc.dat) == length(pbmc_labels))

# Target (pbmc10k): keep sparse genes x cells for efficient pseudobulk rowSums
counts_10k  <- GetAssayData(pbmc10k, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts") # genes x cells (sparse)
labels_10k  <- as.character(pbmc10k$manual_annot_summary)
names(labels_10k) <- colnames(counts_10k)

# Unified cell-type universe (union of both datasets) -- matches DWLS benchmark.
# 'Platelet' exists only in pbmc (reference); its truth proportion is 0 in every bulk,
# but BayesPrism can still emit a (near-zero) estimate for it.
all_celltypes <- sort(union(unique(pbmc_labels), unique(labels_10k)))
cat("Cell-type universe (", length(all_celltypes), "):\n",
    paste(all_celltypes, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")


# --- 4. PSEUDOBULK GENERATION -------------------------------------------------
# Identical logic to the DWLS benchmark: 100 bulks x 1000 cells, summed raw counts.
set.seed(SEED_GLOBAL)
pseudobulk_list <- vector("list", N_BULK)
truth_list      <- vector("list", N_BULK)

for (i in seq_len(N_BULK)) {
  set.seed(100 + i)
  sampled_cells <- sample(colnames(counts_10k), CELLS_BULK)

  # Sum raw counts across sampled cells -> one bulk expression vector (length = n genes)
  bulk_counts   <- Matrix::rowSums(counts_10k[, sampled_cells, drop = FALSE])

  # True proportions over the 9-type union (types absent in the sample get 0)
  tab  <- table(factor(labels_10k[sampled_cells], levels = all_celltypes))
  prop <- as.numeric(tab) / sum(tab)
  names(prop) <- all_celltypes

  pseudobulk_list[[i]] <- bulk_counts
  truth_list[[i]]      <- prop
}

# BayesPrism bulk matrix: samples x genes
bk.dat <- do.call(rbind, pseudobulk_list)                 # N_BULK x genes
rownames(bk.dat) <- paste0("pseudobulk_", seq_len(N_BULK))
storage.mode(bk.dat) <- "double"

# Truth matrix: rows = bulks, cols = cell types
truth_mat <- do.call(rbind, truth_list)
rownames(truth_mat) <- rownames(bk.dat)

cat("Generated ", N_BULK, " pseudobulk samples (", CELLS_BULK, " cells each). ",
    "Bulk matrix: ", nrow(bk.dat), " x ", ncol(bk.dat), " (samples x genes).\n\n", sep = "")


# --- 5. REFERENCE PREPARATION (two arms) --------------------------------------
# Each helper returns a filtered reference matrix (cells x genes) ready for new.prism.
# Labels (pbmc_labels) are unchanged; only the gene space differs between arms.

# 5A. DEFAULT: full published tutorial pipeline --------------------------------
prep_reference_default <- function(sc.dat, cell.type.labels, bk.dat) {
  cat("[DEFAULT] cleanup.genes (Rb/Mrp/other_Rb/chrM/MALAT1/chrX/chrY, exp.cells=",
      EXP_CELLS, ") ...\n", sep = "")
  sc.filt <- BayesPrism::cleanup.genes(
    input       = sc.dat,
    input.type  = "count.matrix",
    species     = SPECIES,
    gene.group  = c("Rb", "Mrp", "other_Rb", "chrM", "MALAT1", "chrX", "chrY"),
    exp.cells   = EXP_CELLS
  )
  cat("  after cleanup.genes: ", nrow(sc.filt), " x ", ncol(sc.filt), "\n", sep = "")

  cat("[DEFAULT] select.gene.type (protein_coding) ...\n")
  sc.pc <- BayesPrism::select.gene.type(sc.filt, gene.type = "protein_coding")
  cat("  after protein_coding subset: ", nrow(sc.pc), " x ", ncol(sc.pc), "\n", sep = "")

  cat("[DEFAULT] get.exp.stat (pairwise t-test across cell states) ...\n")
  # cell.state.labels = cell.type.labels (no finer sub-clustering annotated).
  # Pre-filter genes expressed in > 3 cells to reduce memory, per tutorial.
  gene_keep <- colSums(sc.pc > 0) > 3
  diff.exp.stat <- BayesPrism::get.exp.stat(
    sc.dat            = sc.pc[, gene_keep, drop = FALSE],
    cell.type.labels  = cell.type.labels,
    cell.state.labels = cell.type.labels,
    pseudo.count      = PSEUDO_COUNT,
    cell.count.cutoff = CELL_COUNT_CUT,
    n.cores           = N_CORES
  )

  cat("[DEFAULT] select.marker (pval.max=", PVAL_MAX, ", lfc.min=", LFC_MIN, ") ...\n", sep = "")
  sc.sig <- BayesPrism::select.marker(
    sc.dat   = sc.pc,
    stat     = diff.exp.stat,
    pval.max = PVAL_MAX,
    lfc.min  = LFC_MIN
  )
  cat("  signature reference: ", nrow(sc.sig), " x ", ncol(sc.sig),
      " (cells x marker genes)\n", sep = "")
  return(sc.sig)
}

# 5B. CUSTOM: restrict reference to MarkoClust marker union (no cleanup) -------
prep_reference_custom <- function(sc.dat, markers_list) {
  # Use only cell types that exist in the reference labels
  common_ct   <- intersect(names(markers_list), unique(pbmc_labels))
  if (length(common_ct) == 0)
    stop("No matching cell types between markers and reference labels.")
  all_markers <- unique(unlist(markers_list[common_ct]))
  genes       <- intersect(all_markers, colnames(sc.dat))
  if (length(genes) == 0) stop("No marker genes found in the reference matrix.")

  cat("[CUSTOM] marker union: ", length(all_markers),
      " genes; found in reference: ", length(genes), "\n", sep = "")
  sc.sig <- sc.dat[, genes, drop = FALSE]
  cat("  custom reference: ", nrow(sc.sig), " x ", ncol(sc.sig),
      " (cells x marker genes)\n", sep = "")
  return(sc.sig)
}


# --- 6. BAYESPRISM RUN WRAPPER ------------------------------------------------
# Builds the prism, runs Gibbs sampling, extracts fractions, and aligns predicted
# columns to the 9-type universe (missing types -> 0) so all arms + truth conform.
run_bp <- function(ref_mat, cell.type.labels, bk.dat, method_label, res_file) {
  # Orientation sanity checks: both must be (cells/samples) x genes and share genes.
  stopifnot(nrow(ref_mat) == length(cell.type.labels))
  shared <- intersect(colnames(ref_mat), colnames(bk.dat))
  cat("[", method_label, "] shared genes (reference n bulk): ", length(shared), "\n", sep = "")
  if (length(shared) < 2) stop("Too few shared genes between reference and bulk.")

  # Per-cell-type marker count sanity (tutorial: aim for > 50; warn if fewer)
  # (Only meaningful pre-Gibbs; informational.)

  cat("[", method_label, "] new.prism (key=NULL, cell.state=cell.type) ...\n", sep = "")
  myPrism <- BayesPrism::new.prism(
    reference         = ref_mat,
    mixture           = bk.dat,
    input.type        = "count.matrix",
    cell.type.labels  = cell.type.labels,
    cell.state.labels = cell.type.labels,   # no sub-cluster annotation available
    key               = NULL,               # PBMC: no malignant population
    outlier.cut       = OUTLIER_CUT,
    outlier.fraction  = OUTLIER_FRAC
  )

  cat("[", method_label, "] run.prism (n.cores=", N_CORES, ") ...\n", sep = "")
  set.seed(SEED_BP)
  bp.res <- BayesPrism::run.prism(prism = myPrism, n.cores = N_CORES)

  saveRDS(bp.res, file = res_file)

  # Posterior mean cell-type fractions: samples x cell types (final theta)
  theta    <- BayesPrism::get.fraction(bp = bp.res,
                                        which.theta = "final",
                                        state.or.type = "type")
  theta.cv <- bp.res@posterior.theta_f@theta.cv

  # Align columns to the 9-type universe (missing -> 0), align rows to bulk order
  pred <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(bk.dat), ncol = length(all_celltypes),
                 dimnames = list(rownames(bk.dat), all_celltypes))
  common_ct <- intersect(colnames(theta), all_celltypes)
  pred[rownames(theta), common_ct] <- theta[, common_ct, drop = FALSE]

  cv <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(bk.dat), ncol = length(all_celltypes),
               dimnames = list(rownames(bk.dat), all_celltypes))
  common_cv <- intersect(colnames(theta.cv), all_celltypes)
  cv[rownames(theta.cv), common_cv] <- theta.cv[, common_cv, drop = FALSE]

  list(pred = pred, cv = cv)
}


# --- 7. RUN BOTH ARMS ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== ARM 1: DEFAULT (BayesPrism) =====\n")
ref_default <- prep_reference_default(sc.dat, pbmc_labels, bk.dat)
writeLines(colnames(ref_default), file.path(OUT_DIR, "Sig_default_markers.txt"))
out_default <- run_bp(ref_default, pbmc_labels, bk.dat,
                      method_label = "BayesPrism",
                      res_file     = file.path(OUT_DIR, "bp_res_default.rds"))
pred_default <- out_default$pred

cat("\n===== ARM 2: CUSTOM (ClustoCell-BayesPrism) =====\n")
ref_custom <- prep_reference_custom(sc.dat, pbmc_markoClust_markers)
writeLines(colnames(ref_custom), file.path(OUT_DIR, "Sig_custom_markers.txt"))
out_custom <- run_bp(ref_custom, pbmc_labels, bk.dat,
                     method_label = "ClustoCell-BayesPrism",
                     res_file     = file.path(OUT_DIR, "bp_res_custom.rds"))
pred_custom <- out_custom$pred

# Save raw predictions + truth + CV matrices
saveRDS(list(truth               = truth_mat,
             BayesPrism           = pred_default,
             ClustoCell_BayesPrism = pred_custom,
             cv_BayesPrism        = out_default$cv,
             cv_ClustoCell        = out_custom$cv),
        file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "deconvolution_predictions.rds"))


# --- 8. METRIC FUNCTIONS (identical to DWLS benchmark) ------------------------
metric_summary <- function(truth, pred) {
  stopifnot(length(truth) == length(pred))
  pearson  <- tryCatch(cor(truth, pred, method = "pearson"),  error = function(e) NA_real_)
  spearman <- tryCatch(cor(truth, pred, method = "spearman"), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  ccc      <- tryCatch(DescTools::CCC(truth, pred)$rho.c,     error = function(e) NA_real_)
  tibble(
    Pearson  = pearson,
    Spearman = spearman,
    CCC      = ccc,
    RMSE     = sqrt(mean((pred - truth)^2)),
    MAE      = mean(abs(pred - truth))
  )
}

celltype_metrics <- function(truth_mat, pred_mat, method_name) {
  celltypes <- colnames(truth_mat)
  bind_rows(lapply(celltypes, function(ct) {
    t_vec <- truth_mat[, ct]
    p_vec <- pred_mat[, ct]
    pearson  <- if (sd(t_vec) == 0 || sd(p_vec) == 0) NA_real_ else cor(t_vec, p_vec, method = "pearson")
    spearman <- if (sd(t_vec) == 0 || sd(p_vec) == 0) NA_real_ else cor(t_vec, p_vec, method = "spearman")
    ccc      <- tryCatch(DescTools::CCC(t_vec, p_vec)$rho.c, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    tibble(
      CellType = ct,
      Method   = method_name,
      Pearson  = pearson,
      Spearman = spearman,
      CCC      = ccc,
      RMSE     = sqrt(mean((p_vec - t_vec)^2)),
      MAE      = mean(abs(p_vec - t_vec))
    )
  }))
}

boot_diff_ci <- function(x, y, R = BOOT_R) {
  d <- x - y
  if (length(d) == 0 || all(is.na(d)))
    return(list(Mean = NA_real_, Lower = NA_real_, Upper = NA_real_))
  stat <- function(data, idx) mean(data[idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  b  <- boot::boot(d, statistic = stat, R = R)
  ci <- boot::boot.ci(b, type = "perc")
  list(Mean  = mean(d, na.rm = TRUE),
       Lower = ci$percent[4],
       Upper = ci$percent[5])
}


# --- 9. COMPUTE METRICS -------------------------------------------------------
# Per-pseudobulk
BayesPrism_bulk_metrics <- map_dfr(seq_len(N_BULK), function(i) {
  bind_rows(
    metric_summary(truth_mat[i, ], pred_default[i, ]) %>%
      mutate(Method = "BayesPrism", Bulk = i),
    metric_summary(truth_mat[i, ], pred_custom[i, ]) %>%
      mutate(Method = "ClustoCell-BayesPrism", Bulk = i)
  )
})
# CCC column is a data.frame (est/lwr.ci/upr.ci); keep the point estimate
BayesPrism_bulk_metrics$CCC <- BayesPrism_bulk_metrics$CCC$est

# Per-cell-type
BayesPrism_ct_metrics <- bind_rows(
  celltype_metrics(truth_mat, pred_default, "BayesPrism"),
  celltype_metrics(truth_mat, pred_custom,  "ClustoCell-BayesPrism")
)
BayesPrism_ct_metrics$CCC <- BayesPrism_ct_metrics$CCC$est

write.csv(BayesPrism_bulk_metrics, file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "metrics_per_bulk.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(BayesPrism_ct_metrics,   file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "metrics_per_celltype.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


# --- 10. PAIRED STATISTICAL TESTS ---------------------------------------------
metrics_names <- c("Pearson", "Spearman", "CCC", "RMSE", "MAE")

BayesPrism_stat_results <- map_dfr(metrics_names, function(m) {
  def_vals    <- BayesPrism_bulk_metrics %>% dplyr::filter(Method == "BayesPrism")            %>% dplyr::pull(!!sym(m))
  cust_vals   <- BayesPrism_bulk_metrics %>% dplyr::filter(Method == "ClustoCell-BayesPrism") %>% dplyr::pull(!!sym(m))
  
  tt  <- tryCatch(t.test(cust_vals, def_vals, paired = TRUE),      error = function(e) NULL)
  wt  <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(cust_vals, def_vals, paired = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  bci <- boot_diff_ci(cust_vals, def_vals)   # difference = custom - default
  
  tibble(
    Metric          = m,
    Mean_BayesPrism = mean(def_vals,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_ClustoCell = mean(cust_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Diff_Mean       = bci$Mean,
    CI_Lower        = bci$Lower,
    CI_Upper        = bci$Upper,
    t_pvalue        = if (!is.null(tt)) tt$p.value else NA_real_,
    wilcox_pvalue   = if (!is.null(wt)) wt$p.value else NA_real_
  )
})

write.csv(BayesPrism_stat_results, file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "paired_statistics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(BayesPrism_stat_results)
```

# Purity estimation (done at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute)

## Purpose

This notebook reproduces all correlation values displayed in
`correlation_boxplots_by_cancer.pdf` from the sample-level inputs. It does not
read the saved correlation coefficients to make the plot. Instead, it:

1. joins cell-type singscores to ESTIMATE scores by TCGA sample;
2. calculates Spearman correlations separately for every TCGA project,
   marker method, and major cell type;
3. calculates 2,000-bootstrap percentile confidence intervals;
4. applies Benjamini--Hochberg correction across correlations within each
   marker method;
5. removes Epithelial results from the displayed boxplot;
6. orders cancer types by the median ClustoCell correlation; and
7. saves the final plot as PDF and PNG.

ESTIMATE score is used exactly as generated in the upstream analysis. A
higher ESTIMATE score indicates stronger immune/stromal signal and therefore
lower relative tumor purity.

## Input data and provenance

```{r read-inputs}

scores_path <- "../../../Benchmarking/Purity Benchmark/TCGA Pan-cancer/celltype_scores.csv"
estimate_path <- "../../../Benchmarking/Purity Benchmark/TCGA Pan-cancer/estimate_scores.csv"

scores <- read.csv(
  "../../../Benchmarking/Purity Benchmark/TCGA Pan-cancer/celltype_scores.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

  "../../../Benchmarking/Purity Benchmark/TCGA Pan-cancer/estimate_scores.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

required_score_columns <- c(
  "sample", "method", "major_cluster", "score",
  "tcga_project", "sc_cancer"
)
required_estimate_columns <- c(
  "sample", "estimate", "tcga_project", "sc_cancer"
)
input_summary <- data.frame(
  input = c("Cell-type scores", "ESTIMATE scores"),
  path = c(scores_path, estimate_path),
  rows = c(nrow(scores), nrow(estimate)),
  unique_samples = c(
    length(unique(scores$sample)),
    length(unique(estimate$sample))
  ),
  tcga_projects = c(
    length(unique(scores$tcga_project)),
    length(unique(estimate$tcga_project))
  )
)
knitr::kable(input_summary)
```
