## Correlation analysis

### Analysis functions

```{r correlation-functions}

bootstrap_spearman <- function(x, y, n_boot, seed) {
  if (n_boot < 1L) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(x)
  values <- replicate(n_boot, {
    index <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    if (
      length(unique(x[index])) < 2L ||
        length(unique(y[index])) < 2L
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      suppressWarnings(cor(
        x[index], y[index], method = "spearman"
      ))
    }
  })
  if (sum(is.finite(values)) < max(20L, ceiling(n_boot * 0.8))) {
    return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  }
  unname(quantile(
    values,
    probabilities = c(0.025, 0.975),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  ))
}

correlate_project <- function(
  project_scores,
  project_estimate,
  bootstrap_n,
  seed
) {
  merged <- merge(
    project_scores,
    project_estimate[c("sample", "estimate")],
    by = "sample",
    all = FALSE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  groups <- split(
    seq_len(nrow(merged)),
    interaction(
      merged$method,
      merged$major_cluster,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )
  output <- lapply(seq_along(groups), function(group_number) {
    part <- merged[groups[[group_number]], , drop = FALSE]
    usable <- is.finite(part$score) & is.finite(part$estimate)
    x <- part$score[usable]
    y <- part$estimate[usable]
    status <- "ok"
    rho <- p_value <- ci_low <- ci_high <- NA_real_

    if (length(x) < 3L) {
      status <- "fewer_than_3_samples"
    } else if (
      length(unique(x)) < 2L ||
        length(unique(y)) < 2L
    ) {
      status <- "constant_values"
    } else {
      test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(
        x,
        y,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      ))
      rho <- unname(test$estimate)
      p_value <- test$p.value
      confidence_interval <- bootstrap_spearman(
        x,
        y,
        n_boot = bootstrap_n,
        seed = seed + as.integer(group_number)
      )
      ci_low <- confidence_interval[[1L]]
      ci_high <- confidence_interval[[2L]]
    }

    data.frame(
      method = part$method[[1L]],
      major_cluster = part$major_cluster[[1L]],
      n_samples = length(x),
      spearman_rho = rho,
      ci_low = ci_low,
      ci_high = ci_high,
      p_value = p_value,
      status = status,
      tcga_project = part$tcga_project[[1L]],
      sc_cancer = part$sc_cancer[[1L]]
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, output)
}
```

### Recompute correlations

The same base seed is restarted within each TCGA project, matching the
project-level upstream workflow.

```{r recompute-correlations}
projects <- sort(intersect(
  unique(scores$tcga_project),
  unique(estimate$tcga_project)
))

correlation_tables <- lapply(projects, function(project) {
  project_scores <- scores[
    scores$tcga_project == project,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  project_estimate <- estimate[
    estimate$tcga_project == project,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  correlate_project(
    project_scores,
    project_estimate,
    bootstrap_n = as.integer(params$bootstrap_n),
    seed = as.integer(params$seed)
  )
})
correlations <- do.call(rbind, correlation_tables)
rownames(correlations) <- NULL

correlations$p_adj_bh <- NA_real_
for (method_name in unique(correlations$method)) {
  index <- which(
    correlations$method == method_name &
      is.finite(correlations$p_value)
  )
  correlations$p_adj_bh[index] <- p.adjust(
    correlations$p_value[index],
    method = "BH"
  )
}


write.csv(correlations, "../../../Benchmarking/Purity Benchmark/TCGA Pan-cancer/results/correlations.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

correlation_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  split(
    correlations$spearman_rho[
      is.finite(correlations$spearman_rho)
    ],
    correlations$method[
      is.finite(correlations$spearman_rho)
    ]
  ),
  function(value) {
    data.frame(
      n = length(value),
      minimum = min(value),
      median = median(value),
      maximum = max(value)
    )
  }
))
correlation_summary$method <- rownames(correlation_summary)
rownames(correlation_summary) <- NULL
correlation_summary <- correlation_summary[c(
  "method", "n", "minimum", "median", "maximum"
)]
knitr::kable(correlation_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Reproducibility validation

When the reference correlation table is available, this section confirms
that the recomputed sample counts, coefficients, confidence intervals,
P values, and adjusted P values match the original pipeline.

```{r validate-reference}

reference_path <- "../../../Benchmarking/Purity Benchmark/TCGA Pan-cancer/score_estimate_correlations.csv"
validation <- data.frame(
  reference_available = file.exists(reference_path),
  matched_rows = NA_integer_,
  maximum_rho_difference = NA_real_,
  maximum_ci_difference = NA_real_,
  maximum_p_difference = NA_real_,
  maximum_adjusted_p_difference = NA_real_
)

  reference <- read.csv(
    reference_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  keys <- c(
    "method", "major_cluster", "tcga_project", "sc_cancer"
  )
  comparison <- merge(
    correlations,
    reference,
    by = keys,
    suffixes = c("_recomputed", "_reference")
  )
  finite_max <- function(value) {
    value <- value[is.finite(value)]
    if (length(value)) max(value) else NA_real_
  }
  validation$matched_rows <- nrow(comparison)
  validation$maximum_rho_difference <- finite_max(abs(
    comparison$spearman_rho_recomputed -
      comparison$spearman_rho_reference
  ))
  validation$maximum_ci_difference <- finite_max(c(
    abs(comparison$ci_low_recomputed - comparison$ci_low_reference),
    abs(comparison$ci_high_recomputed - comparison$ci_high_reference)
  ))
  validation$maximum_p_difference <- finite_max(abs(
    comparison$p_value_recomputed -
      comparison$p_value_reference
  ))
  validation$maximum_adjusted_p_difference <- finite_max(abs(
    comparison$p_adj_bh_recomputed -
      comparison$p_adj_bh_reference
  ))

  if (
    nrow(comparison) != nrow(reference) ||
      nrow(comparison) != nrow(correlations)
  ) {
    stop("The recomputed and reference tables do not have identical groups.")
  }
  if (validation$maximum_rho_difference > 1e-12) {
    stop("Recomputed Spearman coefficients do not match the reference.")
  }
  
knitr::kable(validation, digits = 12)
```

## Construct the plotted data

Epithelial results are removed before calculating cancer-level distributions
and ordering. Cancer types are ordered by decreasing median ClustoCell
correlation. The two methods are displaced by 0.14 units around each cancer
position, producing slightly overlapping paired boxplots.

```{r construct-plot-data}
boxplot_data <- correlations[
  is.finite(correlations$spearman_rho) &
    correlations$major_cluster != "Epithelial",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

clustocell_medians <- aggregate(
  spearman_rho ~ tcga_project,
  data = boxplot_data[
    boxplot_data$method == "markoclust",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  FUN = median
)
cancer_order <- clustocell_medians$tcga_project[
  order(
    -clustocell_medians$spearman_rho,
    clustocell_medians$tcga_project
  )
]
boxplot_data$tcga_project <- factor(
  boxplot_data$tcga_project,
  levels = cancer_order
)
boxplot_data$x_position <- as.numeric(boxplot_data$tcga_project) +
  ifelse(boxplot_data$method == "markoclust", -0.14, 0.14)

y_limits <- c(
  floor(min(boxplot_data$spearman_rho) * 10) / 10,
  ceiling(max(boxplot_data$spearman_rho) * 10) / 10
)

ordering_table <- merge(
  data.frame(
    tcga_project = cancer_order,
    plot_position = seq_along(cancer_order)
  ),
  clustocell_medians,
  by = "tcga_project",
  sort = FALSE
)
ordering_table <- ordering_table[
  order(ordering_table$plot_position),
]
knitr::kable(ordering_table, digits = 3)
```

# Performance of ClustoCell markers for dim reduction

## Introduction

Script for evaluation of ClustoCell's Performance for feature extraction for dimension reduction.

## Function Defintion

We first define some helper functions.

```{r}

# Personalized Theme function

styled_theme <- function(
  style = c("academic", "minimal", "modern", "dark", "classic", "void"),
  border_mode = c("default", "all", "none"),
  title_align = c("center", "left", "right"),
  legends_to_drop = NULL,
  axes_title_drop = FALSE,
  legend_position = c("default", "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "inside"),
  axis_title_face = c("regular", "bold"),
  x_axis_text_angle = 45,
  x_axis_text_y = -0.3,
  remove_margin = c("none", "bottom", "all", "top", "left", "right")
) {
  style <- match.arg(style)
  border_mode <- match.arg(border_mode)
  title_align <- match.arg(title_align)
  legend_position <- match.arg(legend_position)
  axis_title_face <- match.arg(axis_title_face)
  remove_margin <- match.arg(remove_margin)

  base_font <- "Helvetica"
  align_map <- c(left = 0, center = 0.5, right = 1)
  hjust_val <- align_map[title_align]
  thin_size <- 0.3  

  # Decide axis title face
  axis_face_val <- ifelse(axis_title_face == "bold", "bold", "plain")

  # Base theme selection
  if (style == "void") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),  
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "academic") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = hjust_val, color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, color = "grey40"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val, size = 13),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "minimal") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic")
      )
  } else if (style == "modern") {
    theme_out <- theme_light(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "dark") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey30", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "white", hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey80", hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "white", face = axis_face_val),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "white", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "classic") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  }

  # Apply border mode
  if (border_mode == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = thin_size))
  } else if (border_mode == "none") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
  }

  # Drop axes titles if requested
  if (axes_title_drop) {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }

  # Override x-axis text angle and vertical position
  theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = x_axis_text_angle,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = x_axis_text_y)
    )
  )

  # Handle margin removal
  if (remove_margin == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "top") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "bottom") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "left") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(l = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "right") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(r = 0))
  }
  # if "none", do nothing

  # Legend positioning override
  if (legend_position != "default") {
    if (legend_position == "inside") {
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
        legend.direction = "vertical"
      )
    } else {
      horiz <- legend_position %in% c("top", "bottom")
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = legend_position,
        legend.direction = if (horiz) "horizontal" else "vertical"
      )
    }
  }

  # Return theme + guides if needed
  if (!is.null(legends_to_drop)) {
    drop_list <- lapply(legends_to_drop, function(x) "none")
    names(drop_list) <- legends_to_drop
    return(list(theme_out, guides(.list = drop_list)))
  } else {
    return(theme_out)
  }
}

label_plt <- function(label = "Label", size = 1) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    # Draw a single vertical bar
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "lightgrey", color = "black") +

             angle = 90, size = 6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5) +

    theme(
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),      # remove outside margins
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),         # remove panel padding
        plot.background = element_blank(),     # no background
        panel.background = element_blank()
    )
}

# Function for calculating the dim reduction trustworthiness

sklearn <- import("sklearn.manifold", convert = TRUE)

compute_trust_sklearn <- function(X_high, X_low, k = 30L, nCells = 10000, seed = 121) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(X_high), nCells)  # sample 10k cells
  
  X_high <- X_high[idx,]
  X_low <- X_low[idx,]
  
  # convert to numeric matrices
  X_high <- as.matrix(X_high)
  X_low  <- as.matrix(X_low)
  
  sklearn$trustworthiness(X_high, X_low, n_neighbors = as.integer(k))
}

# Custom number formatting function
fmt_num <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
    if (abs(v) < 1) {
      # Remove leading zero, keep up to 2 decimals
      sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", v))
    } else {
      # Keep one decimal place
      sprintf("%.1f", v)
    }
  })
}

# Custom number formatting function (3 decimals)
fmt_num3 <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
    if (abs(v) < 1) {
      # Remove leading zero, keep up to 2 decimals
      sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", v))
    } else {
      # Keep one decimal place
      sprintf("%.1f", v)
    }
  })
}

#______________________

# Picking the markers identified by FindAllMarkers
pick_top_markers_equally <- function(markers_df, total_n = 120, padj_cutoff = 0.05) {
  library(dplyr)
  
  df <- markers_df %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < padj_cutoff) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No significant markers under the given cutoff.")
  
  clusters <- unique(df$cluster)
  K <- length(clusters)
  base_take <- floor(total_n / K)
  
  # --- Step 1: Take equal top genes from each cluster
  per_cluster <- df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_head(n = base_take) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  selected <- per_cluster %>%
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)  # remove overlapping genes
  picked_genes <- selected$gene
  
  # --- Step 2: Fill remainder equally if divisible by cluster count
  remaining <- total_n - nrow(selected)
  while (remaining > 0 && remaining %% K == 0) {
    add_k <- remaining / K
    round_more <- df %>%
      filter(!(gene %in% picked_genes)) %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      slice_head(n = add_k) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    selected <- bind_rows(selected, round_more) %>%
      distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
    picked_genes <- selected$gene
    remaining <- total_n - nrow(selected)
  }
  
  # --- Step 3: If remainder not divisible by K, fill globally by top FC
  if (remaining > 0) {
    fill_global <- df %>%
      filter(!(gene %in% picked_genes)) %>%
      arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
      distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      slice_head(n = remaining)
    
    selected <- bind_rows(selected, fill_global) %>%
      distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }
  
  # --- Step 4: Trim if exceeded total_n (just in case)
  selected %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = total_n)
}
```

## GSE131907 LUAD Dataset

## Data preparation

The data was downloaded from https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE131907

```{python}

import gzip

input_file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/GSE131907/GSE131907_Lung_Cancer_raw_UMI_matrix.txt.gz"
output_file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/GSE131907/GSE131907_Lung_Cancer_sparse.mtx"
triplet_file = "temp_triplets.txt"

nnz = 0
row_i = 0

with gzip.open(input_file, 'rt') as f, open(triplet_file, 'w') as trip_f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    ncols = len(header) - 1  # Exclude gene column
    
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(parts) != ncols + 1:
            continue
        row_i += 1
        for col_j in range(1, len(parts)):
            v = parts[col_j]
            if v != '0':
                val = int(v)  # Use int for UMI counts; switch to float if needed
                if val != 0:  # Safety check
                    trip_f.write(f"{row_i} {col_j} {val}\n")
                    nnz += 1
        if row_i % 100 == 0:
            print(f"Processed {row_i} rows, found {nnz:,} non-zeros so far.")

# Assemble final .mtx
with open(output_file, 'w') as mtx_f:
    mtx_f.write("%%MatrixMarket matrix coordinate real general\n")  # Or 'integer' if all ints
    mtx_f.write(f"{row_i} {ncols} {nnz}\n")
    with open(triplet_file, 'r') as trip_f:
        mtx_f.write(trip_f.read())

# Clean up temp file
import os
os.remove(triplet_file)

print(f"Wrote sparse matrix to {output_file} with {nnz:,} non-zero entries.")
```

```{r}
                           "Epithelial cells" ~ "Epithelial",
                           "Fibroblasts" ~ "Fibroblast",
                           "MAST cells" ~ "MAST",
                           "Myeloid cells" ~ "Myeloid",
                           "NK cells" ~ "NK",
                           "Oligodendrocytes" ~ "Oligodendrocyte",
                           "T lymphocytes" ~ "T",
                           "T/NK cells" ~ "T/NK",
                           .default = Cell_type.refined))

## Add additional metadata
luad_GSE131907_metadata_additional <- readr::read_delim("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/GSE131907/Additional meta.txt")
all(luad_GSE131907_metadata_additional$Sample %in% luad_GSE131907_metadata$Sample) # TRUE
luad_GSE131907_metadata <- luad_GSE131907_metadata %>% dplyr::left_join(luad_GSE131907_metadata_additional, by = "Sample")

qs2::qs_save(object = luad_GSE131907_metadata, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/GSE131907/luad_GSE131907_metadata4dimRed.qs2")

luad_GSE131907_so <- CreateSeuratObject(luad_GSE131907_counts, meta.data = luad_GSE131907_metadata, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
rm(luad_GSE131907_counts)

## Saving counts as a BPCells obj so that its smaller and faster for later use
BPCells::write_matrix_dir(mat = luad_GSE131907_so[["RNA"]]$counts, dir = '../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/GSE131907/GSE131907_Lung_Cancer_BPCells')
```

```{r}
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-5, "pt")
  ) +
  labs(subtitle = "HVGs (n=2,000)", 
       color = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = "h") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
```

```{r}
human_melanocyte_clustoCellMarkers_pca_silhouette <- bluster::approxSilhouette(Seurat::Embeddings(object = human_melanocyte_so, reduction = "clusto_pca")[,1:20], 
                                                                   clusters = human_melanocyte_so$class_1)

human_melanocyte_clustoCellMarkers_pca_silhouette <- round(mean(human_melanocyte_clustoCellMarkers_pca_silhouette[, "width"]), 3)

## Calculate trustworthiness
human_melanocyte_clustoCellMarkers_trust_score <- compute_trust_sklearn(X_high = Seurat::Embeddings(human_melanocyte_so, "clusto_pca")[, 1:20], 
                                                            X_low = Seurat::Embeddings(human_melanocyte_so, "clusto_umap"),
                                                            k = 30L, nCells = ncol(human_melanocyte_so), seed = 121)

human_melanocyte_clustoCellMarkers_umap <- CellDimPlot(human_melanocyte_so, reduction = "clusto_umap", group_by = "class_1", 
                                           label = F, pt_size = 2, 
                                           theme = "theme_blank", xlab = "", ylab = "", raster = T,
                                           legend.position = "right", legend.direction = "vertical", palette = "igv") +
  # Add coord_fixed to remove internal axis padding (no expansion around UMAP points)
  coord_fixed(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +  
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
    text = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    # NEW: Remove outer white space around entire plot (top, right, bottom, left)
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 5, l = -5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6.5),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 5, l = -5),      # Internal legend padding
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 5),  # External space to plot (keep slight right for legend fit)
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4.5),
    legend.key.width = unit(0, "pt"),  # Minimize space between point and text
    legend.text.align = 0,
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-6, "pt"),
    legend.key.spacing.x = unit(-4, "pt")
  ) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0("ClustoCell Markers (n=", 
                         length(human_melanocyte_markers$combined_markers), 
                         ")"), 
       color = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, tag = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, bycol = T, override.aes = list(size = 2)))

```

## Based on FinaAllMarkers Matched with ClustoCell Markers

```{r}

human_melanocyte_markers_all <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = human_melanocyte_so,
  group.by = "class_1",
  only.pos = TRUE            # only positive markers (upregulated)
)

                                                            total_n = length(human_melanocyte_markers$combined_markers), 
                                                            padj_cutoff = 0.05)

#_________________

human_melanocyte_so <- ScaleData(human_melanocyte_so, features = human_melanocyte_markers_selected$gene)
human_melanocyte_so <- RunPCA(human_melanocyte_so, features = human_melanocyte_markers_selected$gene, reduction.name = "matched_findAll_pca")
human_melanocyte_so <- RunUMAP(human_melanocyte_so, dims = 1:20, reduction = "matched_findAll_pca", reduction.name = "matched_findAll_umap")
```

## Metrics plot

```{r}

human_melanocyte_dim_red_metrics_df <- tibble(Mode = c("2000\nHVGs", 
                                                "ClustoCell\nMarkers", 
                                                "N-matched\nFindAllMarkers"),
                                       `Silhouette` = c(human_melanocyte_2000_hvg_pca_silhouette,
                                                        human_melanocyte_clustoCellMarkers_pca_silhouette,
                                                        human_melanocyte_matched_findAll_pca_silhouette),
                                       Trustworthiness = c(human_melanocyte_2000_hvg_trust_score,
                                                           human_melanocyte_clustoCellMarkers_trust_score,
                                                           human_melanocyte_matched_findAll_trust_score)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Silhouette", "Trustworthiness"), 
               names_to = "Test", values_to = "Score")

human_melanocyte_dim_red_metrics_df$Mode <- factor(human_melanocyte_dim_red_metrics_df$Mode, 
                                            levels = c("2000\nHVGs",
                                                       "N-matched\nFindAllMarkers",
                                                       "ClustoCell\nMarkers"))

#________________

human_melanocyte_dim_red_metrics_vis <- 
  ggplot(human_melanocyte_dim_red_metrics_df,
         aes(x = Mode, y = Score, fill = Mode)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Test, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_num) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#238A8D", "#6A51A3", "#F06C4E"), name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    tag = "k"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 5),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
    title = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 5, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 5),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4.5),
    legend.text.align = 0,
    legend.key.width  = unit(7, "pt"),
    legend.key.height  = unit(7, "pt"),
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(3, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = -5, l = 0)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(colour = NA, size = 4)
    )
  )

```
